research.purpose: Research the person asked for: one folder per topic, a cited report, its sources, and each researcher's notes
research.rules: Start a topic with `library.mjs new-topic <slug>`. Each researcher writes only its own files in notes/. One synthesizer writes README.md and sources.md. Every claim in README.md cites a source id like [S3] defined in sources.md.

external-docs.purpose: External documentation downloaded word for word as markdown, one folder per site
external-docs.layout: external-docs/<host>/<url path>.md, one line per site in external-docs/catalog.md, one line per page in external-docs/<host>/_outline.md
external-docs.rules: Written only by the documentation-downloader skill (v2), run from /mnt/project-files so its default external-docs/ cache is this area. The librarian catalogues it and never moves it: the skill finds pages by their fixed paths.

notes.purpose: Notes, reviews and memos from threads that are not a research topic
notes.layout: notes/<slug>.md (sharded into notes/<yyyy-mm>/ once it nears the fan-out limit)
notes.rules: Name the file for its subject, lowercase-kebab. Give it frontmatter.

drop.purpose: Anything whose place is unclear: the librarian files it on its next run
drop.rules: Write here instead of guessing a new top-level folder. Add a line of frontmatter saying what it is and who asked for it.

ccp.purpose: The ccp harness: worklog, usage, conformance, items. Written by the ccp plugin's CLI
ccp.rules: Never moved, renamed or edited by the librarian: entries carry sha256 footers and the CLI reads fixed paths.

uploads.purpose: Files the person uploaded in a thread, named by id. Their names are not in the session file list, so the map signposts them
uploads.rules: Never moved: threads refer to them by id. The librarian catalogues their type and first line.
